To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the ENSO variability is modulated by the changes in background mean stratification in a coupled GCM, (2) this modulation is associated with the decadal changes in the equatorial background mean state, (3) this modulation is due to nonlinearities associated with the equatorial wave dynamics, and (4) the decadal variability of the equatorial background state projects differently for different baroclinic vertical modes.
the interdecadal variability of the equatorial mean state can modulate the ENSO amplitude.
the low-frequency changes in the equatorial background state have a strong impact on the interdecadal changes of ENSO variability.
